title: 저출산ㆍ고령사회 기본법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Decision and Notification Regarding Provision of First Meeting Voucher)
① The mayor/governor of a special autonomous city, the governor/mayor of a special autonomous province, the mayor/county executive, and the head of a district office must, in accordance with Article 1(2)(2) of the Act, decide whether to provide a first meeting voucher and notify the applicant of the decision within 30 days from the date the application was received. However, if it takes time to verify factors such as whether the applicant is a parent/guardian, or if there are other special circumstances, the decision can be notified to the applicant within 60 days from the date the application was received, after informing the applicant of the reason.
② The notification required by Article 1(2) must be made using the common form specified in Article 4(2).
